heading: top-left
name: 靠左標題＋小型方形外框圖片網格
desc: 上方靠左的標題組，下方所有項目排成單獨一列小型方形外框卡片，每張卡片中央完整顯示一張圖片。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，桌機上所有項目排成單獨一列、不換行，對齊頁面內容寬度並從左側開始排列；項目都是同一大小的小型方塊，等寬等高。每個項目是一張有外框的方形卡片，卡片內只放一張圖片，置中並完整顯示，四周保留內距；項目明顯小於一般圖片卡片。
mobile: 網格改為多列，每列三個方形卡片，排滿頁面內容寬度，最後一列不足時靠左排列；標題組仍在網格上方靠左。

en.name: Left heading + small square framed image grid
en.desc: A left-aligned heading group above a single row of small square framed cards, each showing one image in full at its center.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. Below the heading group is a grid of multiple items; on desktop all items sit in a single row without wrapping, aligned to the page content width and starting from the left; the items are small squares of the same size, equal in width and height. Each item is a square card with a frame containing only one image, centered and shown in full, with inner padding around it; the items are clearly smaller than typical image cards.
en.mobile: The grid changes to multiple rows of three square cards each, filling the page content width, with an incomplete last row aligned left; the heading group stays above the grid, aligned left.
